purpose: Make Signal -> Decision -> Action -> Proof read as one causal journey rather than four adjacent symbols.

sceneWhole.composition: One continuous left-to-right transparent channel with three physically connected stations visible in the opening tableau.

stations.role: stop, inspect, and visibly release that same signal
receive that same signal and mechanically issue its receipt

sceneWhole.causalRule: Only one meaningful event moves at a time; no downstream event begins before its upstream cause completes.

elements.appearance: one small matte cobalt isometric object
elements.behavior: travels through every station and never duplicates, transforms, or remains behind

elements.appearance: one precisely machined near-black mechanical gate with a thin stop-red inspection indicator
elements.behavior: blocks the signal, performs exactly three inspection ticks, then opens once

elements.appearance: one restrained optic-white stepped water trace
elements.behavior: appears only behind the released signal and physically connects its approved passage

elements.appearance: one small optic-white physical card with a matching embossed cube mark and no legible text
elements.behavior: remains hidden until the signal enters the proof bay, then ejects mechanically

timing.direction: Hold a wider low three-quarter view showing all three connected stations. Nothing moves.
The cobalt signal visibly traverses the inlet and reaches the closed decision gate. Every other element remains still.
The signal stops completely. The gate performs exactly three mechanical inspection ticks, then opens. Nothing downstream moves.
The same cobalt signal crosses the opened gate and travels to the proof bay. One stepped white wake follows directly behind it.
The signal enters the final bay and mechanically triggers the proof receipt. Focus transfers from the signal to the matching receipt.
Hold the completed composition absolutely still for deterministic trimming.

camera.opening: wider low three-quarter tableau showing inlet, gate, and proof bay together for 1.25 seconds
camera.movement: after the establishing hold, one slow left-to-right lateral track follows the signal without losing the next station
camera.ending: one restrained rack focus from the arrived signal to the mechanically issued receipt
avoid: tight crop before the system is established
camera movement unrelated to the signal

audio.narration: First, a signal. Then, a decision. Only then, action—and proof.
synchronization: First, a signal. accompanies the cobalt object's inlet traversal.
Then, a decision. accompanies the three gate inspection ticks.
Only then, action—and proof. begins as the gate opens and ends as the receipt ejects.

invariants: same near-black surface and hard raking light
same onyx, porcelain, quiet grey, and cobalt palette
same tactile 12 fps replacement-animation stop-motion technique
no burned-in captions or legible text
